title: CodeArena: Mini Online Judge
context: Programming contests grade submissions, rank participants and check code for copying.
input: Submissions (user, problem, time, verdict); source strings; problem points.

milestones.title: Verdict statistics
milestones.requirement: Counts per verdict id; the most common verdict.

milestones.title: Problem sets worth 100
milestones.requirement: Count sets of problems whose points total exactly 100 (backtracking).

milestones.title: Plagiarism score
milestones.requirement: LCS of token strings as a similarity measure.

milestones.title: Judge servers
milestones.requirement: Minimum capacity per server so queued batches (in order) finish within 3 rounds.
